title: Measure farther than you step
literal_meaning: Measure a cubit, then move a span.
explanation: Examine more of the situation than the immediate step requires. The proverb recommends deliberation before acting; careful preparation can reduce risk without guaranteeing safety.
meaning_odia: ଯେତିକି ଆଗକୁ ପାଦ ପକାଇବା, ତାଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଦୂରର କଥା ଆଗେ ବିଚାର କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏହା। ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ପଛରେ ସୁଚିନ୍ତିତ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ଥିଲେ ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ବିପଦ କମିପାରେ। ଏହା ସତର୍କ ବିଚାରର ପରାମର୍ଶ, ସବୁ ବିପଦ ଆଗରୁ ଜାଣିହେବ ବୋଲି ନିଶ୍ଚିତତା ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Before moving a workshop, its owners check access, costs and likely demand, then try a small temporary space. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary itself explains the longer measure and shorter step. These are traditional body-based measures; no fixed modern conversion is needed here.

variants.odia:
ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କଲେ
ପ୍ରମାଦ ନପଡ଼ଇ ଭଲେ।
variants.locator: Page31, fifth item beginning ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି.
variants.note: Related-family wording grouped editorially with POD-DHAGA-099 for deliberation before action to avert trouble; no textual descent asserted. Literal reading: If you act with understanding and consideration, misfortune will not befall you. Odia meaning: ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି କାମ କଲେ ପ୍ରମାଦ ପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତି କହୁଛି। ଏହାକୁ ଆମେ କାମର ଅର୍ଥ ଓ ପରିଣାମ ବିଚାର କରି ଆଗେଇବାର ପରାମର୍ଶ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ। ବିଚାର କଲେ ସବୁ ବିପଦ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦୂର ହେବ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ। ମୂଳର ଭଲେ ଶବ୍ଦଟି ରଖାଯାଇଛି; ଅନୁବାଦରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶେଷ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିକୁ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଅନୁସାରେ ବିପଦ ନପଡ଼ିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ନିଆଯାଇଛି। Interpretive reading: Understanding and consideration come before the action. Our editorial reading takes the couplet as encouragement to think through a situation and its consequences before proceeding. Its categorical promise gives the advice force; thoughtful action can still meet unforeseen trouble. Exact uploaded ଭଲେ retained without correction. Its precise final-word nuance remains uncertain; the whole clause is translated contextually as misfortune not befalling one, without adding forehead imagery. Rendered page31 inspected17November2026; source quotation has unknown rights and is excluded from the collection’s original editorial-content licence.

odia_summary: ଆଗକୁ ଭଲଭାବେ ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ନେବା। ଯେତିକି କାମ କରିବା, ତାଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଦୂରର ଫଳ ଭାବିବା।
english_summary: Consider more than the immediate step before acting; care can reduce risk without removing it.
